question: Do three new monetary activity attributes add retrospective out-of-fold information about municipal consumer profiles beyond core and industry context?
scope: Case1 descriptive continuous profiles; no forecasting, causal effects, real output or new cluster selection
primary_target: Sum of squared errors across five CLR coordinates of annual mean monthly normalized published category profiles, equal municipality weight
secondary_target: Log annual mean monthly published total spending
new_features: log(published thousand_rubles *1000 / beginning-of-year population_total); observed, finite and strictly positive source value and population only
interpretation: Nominal territorial activity intensity, not resident income. Retail and the spending target are contemporaneously related constructs, not independent validation sources.
eligibility: Frozen core_eligible and conservative_eligible; do not expand for newly recovered cells
samples: complete_new3 within core; old industry missingness remains
primary_comparison: economic_sectors_newflags vs economic_sectors_newvalues; both retain old8 and new3 missingness indicators
secondary_comparison: economic_newflags vs economic_newvalues, plus explicit missingness-only and total-block comparisons
model: Ridge alpha1, multivariate six coordinates, train-only median imputation and SD scaling, train-only categorical vocabulary; municipality type and region dummies within-region, type only on held-out regions
split: 5 folds, exact prior key-to-fold assignments for core/stable; deterministic new folds for complete_new3 shared across alternatives
uncertainty: 2000 paired region bootstrap resamples of fixed OOF losses, seed13, percentile95%; no refit/full-pipeline interval
prespecified_secondary_ablations: For core seed13 both years and regimes, omit each of investment/shipments/retail in turn from the rich model while retaining all missing flags; contributions need not sum
negative_control: One deterministic diagnostic independently permutes observed new columns within each region in train and test separately, preserving each column's missing positions; no cross-fold donor; not a permutation p-value
slices: population quartile for descriptive slicing only
adoption: Treat as supplementary attributes only if primary joint point gain is >=1% MSE reduction in both years/regimes with positive lower95% bound, and stable-code checks do not reverse it. Failure means narrow or reject that recommendation, not tune the model. Complete-new3 and negative controls must be reported as caveats.
evaluation_contacts: Both2023 and2024 outcomes and selected municipal residual cases were reviewed in prior rounds. This is exploratory evidence, not untouched confirmation.
availability: Annual contemporaneous source values downloaded2026; first release/revisions unknown; no point-in-time availability claim
out_of_scope: promotion to validated stable economic clusters
